image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a pipe organ facade. The image features three distinct sections of vertical metallic pipes housed within ornate wooden casework. The wood is a warm reddish-brown with decorative moldings and carved details. The pipes are silver-colored, varying in height, arranged in symmetrical groups. In the lower right foreground, a portion of the console or stop jamb is visible, featuring rows of white stop knobs with black labels. The lighting is somewhat dim, highlighting the metallic sheen of the pipes against the darker wood.
